mutations.name: L-SELECT
mutations._mechanism: Selecting the greatest listed basename violates the least-name contract.
mutations.find: min(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
mutations.replace: max(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT

mutations.name: L-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Ignoring an unreadable plan hides the error when no readable plan lists the target.

mutations.name: L-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: An unreadable sibling must not override a readable plan listing any canonical name.
mutations.replace: if listed and not any(m.status == "unreadable" for _, plans in per_name for m in plans):  # M:L-LISTED

mutations.name: L-ANY-NAME
mutations._mechanism: Considering only the first canonical name misses a later listed hard-link name.
mutations.find: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names]
mutations.replace: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names[:1]]

mutations.name: L-ABSENT
mutations._mechanism: An absent plan is not an unreadable plan and must yield not-listed.

mutations.name: LV-NONE
mutations._mechanism: A chain with no active records must print not-listed rather than an unreadable verdict.

mutations.name: LV-CHAIN-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: The listing CLI must report the unreadable state file instead of not-listed.

mutations.name: LV-UNREADABLE-ARM
mutations._mechanism: Dropping the unreadable arm of an active chain would print not-listed for a plan that could not be read, admitting a write the listing could not decide.

mutations.name: LV-LISTED-ARM
mutations._mechanism: Dropping the listed arm would print not-listed for a listed target, so the gate would never judge a listed production file.

mutations.name: L-UNREADABLE-RECORD
mutations._mechanism: Recording an unreadable plan as absent would let an undecidable plan read as not-listed, admitting a write the plan may list.

mutations.name: LV-RC
mutations._mechanism: An internal listing exception must return 2 while emitting only stderr.

mutations.name: CX-CALLEE
mutations._mechanism: Disable listing in the callee while keeping the real caller connection.
mutations.find: per_name = [(name, _match_plans(root, name, records)) for name in names]

mutations.name: CX-SELECT
mutations._mechanism: The caller must judge the least listed canonical basename.
mutations.find: min(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT
mutations.replace: max(listed, key=lambda p: p.name), None, "")  # M:L-SELECT

mutations.name: LV-ACTIVE
mutations._mechanism: The listing verb must enter its matcher only on an active chain; otherwise a listed target reads not-listed and an unreadable plan reads allow.

mutations.name: L-ANY-PLAN
mutations._mechanism: A target is listed if ANY plan lists it; requiring ALL plans refuses to list a target that only one of several active plans names.
mutations.find: listed = [name for name, plans in per_name if any(m.matches for m in plans)]
mutations.replace: listed = [name for name, plans in per_name if all(m.matches for m in plans)]

mutations.name: L-READ-RECORD
mutations._mechanism: A readable plan must record the matches it found; dropping them reads every listed target as not-listed.

mutations.name: L-MATCH-RECORD
mutations._mechanism: A production-file match must be recorded; skipping the append reads a listed target as not-listed.

mutations.name: L-NOT-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: The not-listed verdict itself: a target no plan lists must read not-listed, not undecidable (fail-closed direction).

mutations.name: LV-NAMES
mutations._mechanism: Claude's verb must carry every canonical name; keeping only the first misses a listed hard-link name and wrongly admits the write.
mutations.find: names = [root / name for name in args.name]
mutations.replace: names = [root / name for name in args.name[:1]]

mutations.name: LV-CHAIN-TARGET
mutations._mechanism: The chain is read for the target, so state nested under the target's own project governs it; a root-scoped read finds none and wrongly admits the write.

mutations.name: L-ANY-PLAN-FIRST
mutations._mechanism: A target is listed if ANY active plan lists it; consulting only the first plan misses a target that only a later readable plan names, and the write is allowed with its test absent.
mutations.find: listed = [name for name, plans in per_name if any(m.matches for m in plans)]
mutations.replace: listed = [name for name, plans in per_name if any(m.matches for m in plans[:1])]

mutations.name: L-UNREADABLE-ANY-PLAN
mutations._mechanism: The listing is undecidable if ANY plan is unreadable; inspecting only the first plan hides an unreadable later plan and reads the target as not-listed.
mutations.find: for m in plans if m.status == "unreadable"
mutations.replace: for m in plans[:1] if m.status == "unreadable"

mutations.name: LV-RECORDS
mutations._mechanism: The listing verb must hand the matcher every record of the chain; passing only the first record hides a target that a later active plan lists.
